items.summary: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
items.recommend_reason_zh: NVIDIA/auto-ontology 是一个 Python 框架，可在数据之上构建语义图推理层，让 LLM 与智能体工作流的查询生成更确定、上下文检索更准、结果更可解释。
items.recommend_reason_en: NVIDIA/auto-ontology is a Python framework for semantic graph-based reasoning layers over data, with deterministic query generation and explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows, making it worth opening to explore.

items.summary: Turn your AI subscriptions into a team of coworkers
items.recommend_reason_zh: Rerun 能把你的 AI 订阅变成一组协作同事，让订阅的 AI 以团队方式一起工作，值得打开体验。
items.recommend_reason_en: Rerun aims to turn your AI subscriptions into a team of coworkers, and it is worth opening to see how it frames collaborative use of AI tools you already have.

items.summary: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA
items.recommend_reason_zh: garrytan/gstack 提供 Garry Tan 的 Claude Code 配置与 23 个工具，覆盖 CEO、设计、工程管理、发布、文档和 QA，可打开体验完整协作流程。
items.recommend_reason_en: garrytan/gstack packages Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup with 23 opinionated tools for CEO, Designer, Engineering Manager, Release Manager, Documentation Engineer, and QA roles, making it worth opening to inspect a concrete multi-role workflow.

items.summary: Interoperable, efficient memory layer for agentic AI
items.recommend_reason_zh: Living Brain 为智能体 AI 提供可互操作、高效的内存层，适合想了解智能体记忆如何高效衔接的人打开体验。
items.recommend_reason_en: Living Brain is an interoperable, efficient memory layer for agentic AI that is worth opening to explore its approach to memory for AI agents.
